charge_port.notes: Tesla's own connector (now NACS / SAE J3400) is used on all Tesla vehicles including the Model 3 (Wikipedia). Canadian and US cars alike.

supercharger_access.notes: Tesla's own Supercharger network, built for this connector (Wikipedia).

wheels.notes: Base-trim wheel on the cars.com page for that era. Cars.com 2024 page shows the RWD trim only; this trim (Canada market) is carried from it.
